metadata._source: OSM Overpass API (https://overpass-api.de/api/interpreter, mirror https://lz4.overpass-api.de/api/interpreter) and Nominatim (https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search), queried 2026-08-19
metadata._note: HONEST GAP: Pune Municipal Corporation (PMC) and Pimpri-Chinchwad Municipal Corporation (PCMC) have NO administrative boundary polygon in OpenStreetMap as of this fetch. Verified two ways: (1) Overpass search for boundary=administrative relations named "Pune Municipal Corporation" / "Pimpri Chinchwad Municipal Corporation" / admin_level 7 or 8 anywhere in the Pune bbox (18.4,73.6 to 18.8,74.0) returned zero results — only taluka-level (admin_level=6) relations exist. (2) Nominatim search for both names returns only POI buildings (the PMC head office, the PCMC head office/station) and, for the cities themselves, bare place=city POINT nodes (osm node 16174445 for Pune, osm node 1600720975 for Pimpri-Chinchwad) with no associated polygon. Ward/Prabhag-level (admin_level 9/10) boundaries were also searched for and not found. This is a real, common gap for Indian municipal-corporation boundaries in OSM, not a fetch failure — do not assume a retry will find it.
metadata._whatWasFetched: The best real polygon granularity actually available: admin_level=6 (taluka/subdistrict) boundaries for Pune City Subdistrict and Haveli Subdistrict, which together cover essentially all of PMC + PCMC (plus substantial rural area beyond both — these are coarser than a true municipal boundary, use with that caveat). Also includes place=city center points for Pune and Pimpri-Chinchwad (population-tagged OSM nodes, real but a single point each, not a boundary).
metadata._nextSteps: To get real PMC/PCMC polygons, options are: (a) digitize from the PMC/PCMC GIS portals if they publish one, (b) trace from an official ward-map PDF, (c) approximate PMC/PCMC extent as the union/intersection of these taluka polygons with the known seeded-locality points in src/data/localities.pune.json, honestly labeled as an approximation. None of these were attempted here — flagging for a follow-up decision rather than guessing.
